data.narrative:
Magdrive is a seed-stage space & aerospace company founded by Mark Stokes and Thomas Clayson that has raised $22.5M to date. The broader Space & Aerospace sector comprises 6 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE, though a sufficiently tight peer cohort at identical stage and valuation tier was not available for reliable median benchmarking.

Of three valuation methods examined, only stage-progression proved applicable. Using total capital raised ($22.5M) as a baseline value proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $56M. Public-comp anchoring could not be executed because target revenue is not on file—essential for P/S multiples—and peer-median analysis could not proceed due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage private comparables within Space & Aerospace (1 narrow-filter match versus the 3+ required for statistical confidence).

The single-method result produces a range of $48M to $65M, with a median of $56M. This valuation rests entirely on the stage-progression framework and should be treated as illustrative pending either access to Magdrive's revenue figures (enabling public-comp triangulation) or emergence of additional seed-stage Space & Aerospace comparables. Key uncertainties include technology maturity, commercial traction, and capital efficiency relative to peer cohorts.
